directAnswer: To test a passkey, use the authentication feature of your device or application that supports passkeys, ensuring it prompts for the passkey entry during login.
summary: Testing a passkey involves verifying its functionality through supported platforms and applications to ensure secure access.

sections.heading: Understanding Passkeys
sections.body: Passkeys are a secure way to authenticate users without relying on traditional passwords. They are designed to be resistant to phishing attacks.

sections.heading: Platform-Specific Testing Steps
sections.body: Testing methods may vary depending on the platform you are using. Below are common platforms.

steps.title: Testing on Windows
steps.detail: Navigate to Settings > Accounts > Sign-in options. Under 'Security Key', choose 'Manage' and follow prompts to test the passkey.

steps.title: Testing on macOS
steps.detail: Open System Preferences > Users & Groups. Click on 'Login Options' and set up your passkey under the 'Security' section.

steps.title: Testing on Android
steps.detail: Go to Settings > Google > Manage your Google Account > Security. Under 'Signing in to Google', select 'Use your passkey' to test.

steps.title: Testing on iOS
steps.detail: Open Settings > Passwords. Tap on 'AutoFill Passwords' and ensure your passkey is listed. Test by logging into an app that supports passkeys.

faqs.question: What should I do if my passkey doesn't work?
faqs.answer: Ensure that your device's software is updated and that the application supports passkeys. You may also need to reset the passkey.

faqs.question: Can I use a passkey on multiple devices?
faqs.answer: Yes, as long as the devices are linked to the same account and support passkey authentication.

faqs.question: What happens if I lose my device with the passkey?
faqs.answer: You should have recovery options set up, such as backup codes or alternative authentication methods, to regain access.

caveats: Not all applications or services support passkeys, so verify compatibility before testing.
The steps may vary slightly based on the version of the operating system.
